text:
A circuit is set up with a gap between two terminals X and Y. The four strips of material shown in
the diagram are connected in turn across the gap.
Which strip completes the circuit so that the lamp lights?
A
B
C
D
wood
glass
steel
rubber
X
Y
subject: Physics
